notes: Unmeasured template: deliberately rejected. Use complete real-data batch-256 update profiles. Measure checkpoint_seconds_per_save for each arm; set checkpoint_interval_updates to its chosen integer cadence in 1..5000. Per-suite episode durations must conservatively account for timeout-length episodes, model calls, settling/rendering and server startup/checkpoint loading. Set experiment_identity.code_commit and .container_image_id to the pinned source and Docker image. Completed training records contain group, training_seed, optimizer_updates and checkpoint_dir; their actual research metadata and weight hashes are verified. Completed evaluation records contain group, training_seed (null for reference), num_steps, suite and manifest_path; complete 500-episode suite logs and provenance must validate. Fixed cost includes all spending so far plus storage, taxes and remaining noncompute costs. --select-study preserves full 30000-update runs and 40000 or 16000 planned episodes, subtracting only validated completed work. Retain all evidence paths alongside this file.
